name: Sangfor Technologies Inc.
summary: Sangfor Technologies Inc. provides IT infrastructure, cloud computing, and network security solutions in China and internationally. The company offers cyber security products, including Sangfor Network Secure Firewall platform; Sangfor Cyber Command, an intelligent threat detection and response platform; Sangfor Endpoint Secure for extensive malware protection; Internet Access Gateway, a securely manage internet access; SASE Sangfor Access Secure, a cloud-based SASE for branch offices and remote users; Sangfor Platform-X, a cloud-based security management platform, a secure remote access solution that allows to access Windows desktops and applications from any device or operating system; and…
